# CHGO API R3 Auth + R4 Vault Privacy Negative Test Pack 1.0

Pre-development executable test pack.

- 18 negative security/privacy cases are defined.
- Pack integrity tests can run immediately.
- Runtime API tests are deliberately skipped until a real dev/staging base URL and test credentials/fixtures are supplied.
- Never commit real tokens, provider credentials, diary content, KMS keys, or production identifiers.
- Runtime PASS requires evidence from a controlled non-production environment unless separately approved.
